protocol: prereg step 4: proposals pooled, provenance stripped, stable-sha256 order, FRESH independent Sonnet auditor sees ONLY round2_proposals_blinded.json; disputes with the proposing track adjudicated by a frontier (Opus) arbiter

final.name: Discriminative evaluation — designed to decide between hypotheses, not to demonstrate the method
final.audit_justification: Directly asks whether the evaluation design could actually distinguish competing answers rather than just showcase a win, which is a core methodological merit.

final.name: Belief-change — the output is a changed understanding rather than a delivered artifact
final.audit_justification: The instruction explicitly says both options are 'legitimate contributions' and scores only which type is offered, so it tracks contribution genre rather than merit.

arbiter.model: Opus (frontier arbiter; criterion text + auditor verdict + proposer rationale)
arbiter.reason: As written the instruction is indifferent to merit by explicit stipulation ('Both are legitimate contributions; score only which one the abstract is offering'), so a judge obeying it returns a genre label. A genre marker is not relevantly different from the topic/subfield markers both parties already exiled: all partition items on a value-neutral axis, draw their lift from corpus composition, and flip sign under a different venue mix. The consistency check with 'Reusable artifact' survives intact because declared nuisances are still scored. Salvage rewrite supplied for a LATER round (must enter as a fresh Track-A proposal under freeze-before-eval, not swapped in mid-round).

final.name: Cost stated TOGETHER WITH gain, so the trade is checkable
final.audit_justification: Whether costs and gains are both quantified in commensurable terms directly measures the abstract's honesty and completeness about the real trade-off being offered.

final.name: Limiting result stated TOGETHER WITH the conditions under which it holds
final.audit_justification: Requiring a stated limitation to also carry its scope conditions tracks epistemic honesty and precision about the work's actual boundaries.

final.name: Hedging-word density
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores hedge-word frequency 'not whether the hedging is warranted,' i.e., pure linguistic register.

final.name: Theory and experiment coupled — the experiments test the theory's own prediction
final.audit_justification: Checks whether the reported experiments genuinely target the theory's own prediction rather than generic performance, a real test of argumentative coherence.

final.name: Explicit priority or first-ness claims
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores the rhetorical assertion of priority 'not whether it is true,' i.e., a boilerplate phrase pattern.

final.name: Precise delta — prior work is characterised specifically enough that the change is checkable
final.audit_justification: Specificity about what prior work does and what changes is exactly what makes a claimed contribution checkable, a genuine evidentiary property.

final.name: Derivation coupling — the problem's structure is established first and the method is derived from it
final.audit_justification: Asks whether the method is actually presented as following from an established structural fact rather than being ad hoc, though its order-based operationalization ('before naming its method') risks rewarding narrative sequencing over real derivation.

final.name: Generality of the formal statement TOGETHER WITH concreteness of its instantiation
final.audit_justification: Judges whether a general claim is backed by a concrete, implementable instantiation, a substantive property of a theoretical contribution's usefulness and testability.

final.name: Syntactic complexity independent of total length
final.audit_justification: Purely a sentence-syntax/style measure (clause length, subordination) independent of content.

final.name: Rhetorical questions posed in the abstract
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores the rhetorical-question device itself, a framing mannerism unrelated to the underlying claim.

final.name: Restraint — claim language is calibrated BELOW what the reported results would license
final.audit_justification: Measures whether claim strength is calibrated to actual result magnitude, a genuine overclaiming/honesty check, unlike P05 it explicitly ties language to warrant.

final.name: Non-idiomatic English and grammatical slips
final.audit_justification: Explicitly scores surface fluency and grammar 'not the clarity of the underlying ideas,' conflating with authors' language background rather than research merit.

final.name: Membership in the privacy / security / adversarial-robustness subfield
final.audit_justification: Explicitly 'topic membership only' -- a subfield label with no bearing on the work's quality.

final.name: Subsumption — prior work is exhibited as special cases of a more general statement
final.audit_justification: Subsuming prior approaches as special cases of a general statement is a substantive theoretical-unification contribution.

final.name: Reusable artifact — what is left behind is fit for others to build on, judged scale-free
final.audit_justification: Scores the artifact's actual novelty, documentation, and fitness for reuse, not merely whether one exists, so it tracks real contribution quality.

final.name: Mechanistic explanation of an OBSERVED fact, not of the proposed method
final.audit_justification: Rewards explaining why an observed real-world phenomenon occurs, a genuine explanatory contribution distinct from self-justifying one's own method.

final.name: Simplicity of the solution RELATIVE TO the difficulty of the problem it solves
final.audit_justification: Weighs solution economy against established problem difficulty, a real parsimony/elegance merit, though vulnerable to abstracts that merely assert difficulty or simplicity rhetorically.

final.name: Names and characterises a phenomenon that did not previously have a name
final.audit_justification: Identifying and characterizing a new, generalizable phenomenon (not just naming one's own method) is a genuine scientific contribution.

final.name: Insight portability — the finding would survive replacing the specific benchmark it was shown on
final.audit_justification: Asks whether the finding is a portable fact about the world versus an artifact of one benchmark, a real generalizability/validity concern.

final.name: First-person narrative density
final.audit_justification: Explicitly 'count the register only' -- a first-person-voice stylistic tic, not a property of the research.

final.name: Typographic emphasis used inside the abstract
final.audit_justification: Scores use of bold/italics markup 'regardless of what is emphasised,' pure typography.

final.name: Acronym density
final.audit_justification: Scores acronym frequency alone, a notational-density measure unrelated to substance.

final.name: Inline author-year citations inside the abstract
final.audit_justification: Scores inline citation format 'not whether the citations are apt,' a citation-convention practice.
